plotSpecSignature: PlotSpec(title: str, subtitle: str = '', xlabel: str = '', ylabel: str = '', note: str = '', signature: str = 'figurestead')

line.signature: line(x, ys, *, labels=None, spec=None, theme='slipware', profile='deep_scope', ax=None, pose=None, focus=None)
line.input: x is one finite one-dimensional sequence; ys is one series or a two-dimensional series-by-x array; every series and label must match exactly

scatter.signature: scatter(x, y, *, series=None, spec=None, theme='slipware', profile='deep_scope', ax=None)
scatter.input: x and y are equal-length finite one-dimensional sequences; optional series has the same length

histogram.signature: histogram(values, *, labels=None, bins=20, spec=None, theme='slipware', profile='deep_scope', ax=None)
histogram.input: values is one finite numeric dataset, or a list/tuple of finite datasets; labels must match the dataset count

strip_summary.signature: strip_summary(groups, values, *, series=None, order=None, spec=None, theme='slipware', profile='deep_scope', ax=None, seed=42)
strip_summary.input: groups and finite values have equal length; optional series matches; authored order is unique and accounts for observed categories

heatmap.signature: heatmap(matrix, *, xlabels=None, ylabels=None, spec=None, theme='slipware', profile='deep_scope', ax=None)
heatmap.input: matrix is finite, numeric, rectangular, and two-dimensional; xlabels match columns and ylabels match rows

fitPolicy: The static Python convenience scatter does not select or compile a fit. Compute a scientifically authorized model explicitly and label it by name.
inputPolicy: Reject masked arrays, NaN, infinity, silent label truncation, and ambiguous ordering before calling the released convenience API. Runtime permissiveness is not permission to reinterpret data.
